newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Monday's loss.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Monday's loss.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Monday's 1.4-percent loss, as the market, which had risen over three percent during its previous three sessions, was not seen breaking out of its three-month flat trend.
Some analysts said if Bank Handlowy's final issue price, due on Tuesday, came in toward the top of its 28-35 zloty price range, the market could receive a psychological lift.
They said some stocks could be affected by May earnings reports due on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Confectioner Mieszko SA starts trade on the parallel floor.
